text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending prohibiting parking on the north side of Westwood Avenue, between a point 31 metres east of Burley Avenue to a point 27 metres further east. This proposal will legalize the existing posted signage. During the course of the investigation, it was noted that there is a discrepancy between posted signs and the existing parking regulations. The recommendations will correct this inconsistency.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item indefinitely.
